name: Big-favourite moneyline (no line)
rule: Frozen before the first bet. Any change to signal, threshold, universe or settlement is a NEW strategy with a NEW id and a new hash; the old record is never edited, so a reader can always tell whether the rule moved.
settlement_rule: side correct if the picked club wins.
thesis: High-conviction projections are where a probabilistic model should be most accurate; if it is not, the probability scale is wrong.
